tickets.title: Give every tapered frontier its own flow and discrepancy target
tickets.first_deliverable: Replace the all-active ordinary LocalIntegerFlow wrapper by a shape-indexed family; prove receiver counts and conservation through bootstrap, a symbolic six-stage cycle, and meeting.
tickets.notes: Initialized actual ownership schedule with shape-specific even splits, empty inactive registers, count error at most 69 through bootstrap, every six-stage segment, and the terminal meeting. Fresh expansion sources generate exact cohort history for contraction. Static-debt bootstrap replaces the old uniform reset; local comparator realization and rank/native-prefix correctness remain UB-22/UB-24. Fresh 32-module source rebuild and four standard-axiom guards passed on 2026-10-14; no new sorting-depth coefficient is claimed. UB-24 additionally identifies exact subtree balance at retirement as a stronger requirement not supplied by the local rounding contract; UB-23 remains complete for its stated ownership/count scope.

tickets.title: Prove the signed native-prefix rank profile before extending the outsider induction
tickets.first_deliverable: Prove the clipped prefix-count identity and the exact bootstrap profile; close a symbolic six-stage ordinary/frontier rank recurrence with native-prefix cancellation, cohort errors and a valid upper-retirement rule.
tickets.notes: Partial kernel-checked results only: exact clipped threshold/interval identities, separator crossing-to-deficit bound, actual initialized schedule prefix recurrence, and threshold cohort conservation. Retirement requires exact native component cardinalities. Two admissible top-advance local profiles at C=2^40 differ by two wires, so the current rounding contract alone does not force retirement balance; this is not a counterexample to the selected trace. Cumulative even rounding proves a local retirement complement lemma under exact source conservation. A formula-level audit finds global target mass is exactly 64^d, while proper active-subtree target mass generally has a nonzero native-capacity deficit C_r/cap + (16/15)eC_r. The needed laminar invariant must track the ancestor-retained reserve; independently rounding raw subtree targets cannot work. The mixed meeting real-mass identity is consistent. Next: prove and integrate the ancestor-reserve invariant, then close the exact static-debt bootstrap profile, six-stage signed rank-error recurrence, and terminal localization. No global rank invariant or improved sorting-depth constant is claimed.
